statement: Mapped hydrography identities are leads. They do not establish usable livestock water, year-round reliability, water quality, or a legal right to drink or divert. Ask what source is claimed — well, tank, pond, or seasonal channel — and for any records. Do not invent a well or drinker.
source_title: Mapped water is not stock water (CPER trial card)
source_publisher: RangeMatch trial card — not an official knowledge base
review_basis: Provisional CPER test only; diligence questions, not parcel inventory.
